title.en: Frontier AI model prices collapse 5-10x as OpenAI, Meta, and xAI launch competing low-cost models in a single week
title.zhHans: 前沿 AI 模型价格一周内暴跌 5-10 倍——OpenAI、Meta、xAI 相继推出低价模型展开竞争

searchSummary.en: AI Model Price War (Jul 2026) — Within a single week, xAI's Grok 4.5 at $2/$6, Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 at $1.25/$4.25, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna drove frontier output token pricing from $25-50 down to $4-6 per million tokens. A 5-10x collapse in AI inference costs that reshaped industry economics.
searchSummary.zhHans: AI 模型价格战（2026 年 7 月）——一周之内，xAI 的 Grok 4.5（$2/$6）、Meta 的 Muse Spark 1.1（$1.25/$4.25）以及 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Luna 将前沿模型输出 token 价格从 $25-50 压低至 $4-6。AI 推理成本 5-10 倍暴跌，重塑行业经济结构。

summary.en: Between July 7 and July 13, 2026, three major AI labs launched or restructured pricing for frontier models within days of each other, triggering a price war that cut output token costs from $25-50 per million tokens to $4-6 — a 5-10x reduction. xAI released Grok 4.5 at $2/$6 per million tokens (input/output) on July 7-9, optimized for coding and agentic tasks. Meta opened its first paid API on July 9 with Muse Spark 1.1 at $1.25/$4.25, undercutting all competitors. OpenAI responded with competitive pricing for GPT-5.6 Luna, part of its broader Sol/Terra/Luna family released on July 8-9. Analysts described the pricing shift as the beginning of a structural transformation in AI economics: frontier model access was no longer a premium product.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 7 日至 13 日间，三家主要 AI 实验室在数日内相继发布或调整前沿模型定价，引发了一场价格战，将输出 token 成本从每百万个 $25-50 降至 $4-6——降幅达 5-10 倍。xAI 于 7 月 7-9 日以 $2/$6（输入/输出）的价格发布 Grok 4.5，针对编程和智能体任务优化。Meta 于 7 月 9 日以 $1.25/$4.25 的价格开放首个付费 API Muse Spark 1.1，低于所有竞争对手。OpenAI 则以 GPT-5.6 Luna 的竞争性定价回应，该模型是其于 7 月 8-9 日发布的 Sol/Terra/Luna 系列的一部分。分析师将此次调价描述为 AI 经济结构转型的开端：前沿模型访问不再是一种高端产品。

narrative.en: The first half of 2026 had already seen aggressive pricing from DeepSeek V4 ($0.87/M output) and Claude Sonnet 5's introductory pricing ($2/$10). But the week of July 7-13 marked an inflection point. xAI's Grok 4.5, built jointly with Cursor, entered the market at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens — roughly 33% less than GPT-5.6 Sol on comparable tasks while matching or beating it on coding benchmarks. Two days later, Meta opened its first paid API: Muse Spark 1.1 at $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens. The model featured a 1-million-token context window, computer-use capabilities, and parallel subagent delegation. OpenAI, fresh off the July 8 government approval for GPT-5.6's broad launch, priced the Luna variant competitively against both newcomers. The combined effect was dramatic. Output token prices for frontier models dropped from the $25-50 range that had prevailed through most of the first half of 2026 to $4-6. Forbes noted that cheaper tokens alone would not guarantee cheaper enterprise agents, due to the overhead of model orchestration, verification, and integration. But for high-volume API users and startups, the cost reduction was transformative. The price war had structural implications. First, it signaled the end of the 'frontier premium' — the assumption that the most capable models would command the highest prices. Second, it demonstrated that open-weight and cost-efficient architectures (MoE, aggressive quantization, efficient attention) had reached parity with proprietary approaches on price-performance. Third, it raised questions about sustainability: at $4-6 per million output tokens, even well-funded AI labs faced pressure on margins. The event accelerated the commoditization of frontier AI and reinforced the trend toward volume-driven economics rather than margin-driven pricing.
narrative.zhHans: 2026 年上半年已经出现了 DeepSeek V4（每百万输出 token $0.87）和 Claude Sonnet 5 的入门定价（$2/$10）等激进定价。但 7 月 7-13 日这一周标志着一个转折点。xAI 的 Grok 4.5（与 Cursor 联合构建）以每百万输入 token $2 和每百万输出 token $6 的价格进入市场——在可比任务上比 GPT-5.6 Sol 便宜约 33%，同时在编程基准上与其匹敌或超越。两天后，Meta 开放了其首个付费 API：Muse Spark 1.1，每百万输入 token $1.25，每百万输出 token $4.25。该模型拥有 100 万 token 上下文窗口、计算机使用能力和并行子智能体委托功能。OpenAI 刚刚在 7 月 8 日获得政府对 GPT-5.6 广泛发布的批准，将 Luna 变体定价为对两个新进入者具有竞争力。综合效应是戏剧性的。前沿模型的输出 token 价格从 2026 年上半年大部分时间普遍的 $25-50 区间降至 $4-6。福布斯指出，仅靠更便宜的 token 并不能保证更便宜的企业智能体，因为模型编排、验证和集成有额外开销。但对于高容量 API 用户和初创公司来说，成本降低是变革性的。这场价格战具有结构性影响。首先，它标志着"前沿溢价"的终结——即最有能力的模型将定价最高的假设。其次，它表明开源权重和高效架构（MoE、激进量化、高效注意力）在性价比上已与专有方法达到同等水平。第三，它引发了可持续性问题：在每百万输出 token $4-6 的情况下，即使是资金充足的 AI 实验室也面临利润率压力。这一事件加速了前沿 AI 的商品化，并强化了从利润率驱动定价向容量驱动经济学的转变。

description.en: Frontier model output token prices collapsed from $25-50 to $4-6 per million tokens — a 5-10x reduction in one week. This structural shift dramatically lowered the cost barrier for AI application development and enterprise adoption.
description.zhHans: 前沿模型输出 token 价格从每百万个 $25-50 暴跌至 $4-6——一周内下降 5-10 倍。这一结构性转变大幅降低了 AI 应用开发和部署的成本门槛。

description.en: Meta's first paid API at $1.25/$4.25 and Grok 4.5 at $2/$6 made frontier-class AI accessible to a broader developer base, including those who had been priced out by $25-50/M output legacy flagships.
description.zhHans: Meta 首个付费 API（$1.25/$4.25）和 Grok 4.5（$2/$6）使前沿级 AI 对更广泛的开发者群体变得可及，包括那些曾被 $25-50/M 输出的传统旗舰定价排除在外的人。

description.en: Sustained low pricing may pressure AI labs to cut safety infrastructure and alignment research, as margins shrink. The commoditization of frontier AI could also accelerate misuse by lowering the cost of running unaligned or malicious models.
description.zhHans: 持续的低价可能迫使 AI 实验室在利润收缩时削减安全基础设施和对齐研究。前沿 AI 的商品化也可能因降低运行未对齐或恶意模型的成本而加速滥用。

sources.quote: OpenAI said its most advanced offering, GPT-5.6, is designed to complete more work while using significantly fewer tokens.
Cheaper AI Tokens Do Not Guarantee Cheaper Enterprise Agents.
The developer API is priced at $4.25 per million output tokens.
Elon Musk's xAI unveiling Grok 4.5 with usage fees up to 76% cheaper than competitors.
Grok 4.5, GPT-5.6 and Muse Spark 1.1 shift options for cloud and dev.
Driving output token costs down to the $4 to $6 range, compared to $25 to $50 for legacy flagships.
